name: Handel's Homemade Ice Cream Vista
notes: Photos 1 and 2 are just the flavor-name boards (flavor lists, no prices) — flavors are choices within a scoop/cone/sundae, not separate priced dishes, so they were not transcribed as individual dishes. Photo 3 is the actual priced menu board and is the source for all dishes below. Skipped as modifiers/add-ons: Extra Cone or Dish, Extra Waffle Cone, Dipped Waffle Cone, Dipped Cone with Topping, Extra Toppings/Nuts, Pecans. Sundae and Hurricane flavor/mix-in choices are listed as descriptions rather than exploded into separate dishes. Ice Cream Cakes & Pies is priced as a range ($35-$45) on the board, so no single price is given.
